params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: Trade and sector sources for resale, retail and jobs in the energy transition should be read as fixed feeds, so a deck can cite them from Gentells instead of from the open web.

Source: Portal mail:51.

## What is asked

Read as fixed feeds:

- RetailDetail, for resale and retail
- EEA (European Environment Agency) and EHPA (European Heat Pump Association), for jobs in the energy transition
- Vinted's annual results

## Where this stands (checked 2026-11-15)

| Source | In Gentells | Feed |
|---|---|---|
| RetailDetail BE (`source-gt-096`) | proposed since 21 October, never read | live |
| RetailDetail EU (`source-gt-116`) | proposed since 21 October, never read | live |
| RetailDetail NL | muted | |
| EEA | not held | `eea.europa.eu/en/newsroom/rss.xml`, live |
| EHPA | not held | `ehpa.org/feed/`, live |
| Vinted Newsroom (`source-gt-042`) | listed, no feed, never read | none |

## What is needed

1. EEA and EHPA as rows in the source list of 15 November (proposed, with their feeds).
2. On the box, after the import: start the trial for the four feeds (RetailDetail BE and EU, EEA, EHPA) with `bin/source-state.mjs trial`. A person runs this; signals from a trial stay off the record until the source is admitted with its terms, about 14 days later.
3. Vinted's annual results appear once a year and have no feed. That is a figure, not a stream: it is better held as a statistic at its origin (the yearly results release) than as a feed.
params.title: Read the trade and sector sources as fixed feeds (RetailDetail, EEA, EHPA, Vinted, Securex press room)
